XMLDB.COMMENT: Nucleus hub sign-in: which hub account each local account belongs to (ADR-023).

TABLE.NAME: auth_nucleus_link
TABLE.COMMENT: Links a local account to one hub account: the issuer and the hub's subject identifier. Sign-in finds accounts only through this table, never by email.

FIELD.NAME: issuer
FIELD.COMMENT: The hub issuer the link belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: issuerhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 (hex) of issuer. Moodle can't index a 1333-character column, so the unique index uses this.

FIELD.NAME: sub
FIELD.COMMENT: The hub's subject identifier for the person: 32 lower-case hex characters.

FIELD.NAME: previousauth
FIELD.COMMENT: The account's login method before it was linked, restored when sign-in with the hub is turned off. Null for accounts the hub sign-in created.

KEY.NAME: userid
KEY.COMMENT: One hub account per local account.

INDEX.NAME: issuerhash_sub
INDEX.COMMENT: One local account per hub account of an issuer.
